title: Five Seconds to Air (Soft-Clay Studio Comedy)

scenes.title: Five Seconds to Air — Maya & Leo Studio Banter
scenes.speaker: Leo & Maya
scenes.text: [warmly] Relax, Maya — we still have five whole minutes before the red light comes on. [playful] Uh, Leo? That clock says five seconds — not five minutes! [excited] Wait — FIVE?! My mic isn't even straight, hold the camera! [chuckles] Three, two, one — smile! [warmly] Good evening, everyone — welcome back to the calmest show in town. [playful] Totally planned every single second.
